name: typewriter tagline over crossfading full-bleed photos
looks: A short tagline types on word by word, one or two words added per beat, while the full-bleed photo behind it keeps crossfading to a new, unrelated image every beat: a portrait, a close-up of flowers, an aerial coastline, a fashion shot. The words accumulate into one finished line by the last photo.
build: Full-bleed photo layers cross-dissolve on opacity every 0.5-0.6s, each a different seeded image; the tagline text is one DOM line revealed with kit.typeOn, timed so a new word or two lands with each photo swap rather than finishing early.
sound: A soft whoosh under each photo crossfade and a light tick as each new word lands.
prompt: Type a short tagline on word by word while the full-bleed photo behind it keeps crossfading to a different, unrelated image on the same beat the words land, so the line finishes just as the photos stop changing. Keep every photo honestly generic stock, not a real campaign.
